chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Bashir ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you intend something of the good, do not delay it, for the servant fasts on a hot day intending what is with Allah, so Allah frees him from the Fire because of it, and do not consider small what you draw near to Allah with, even if it is half a date.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of hastening good deeds and not belittling small acts of worship in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the virtue of *tabarru'* (hastening) in good deeds, warning against procrastination even when the act is difficult. He illustrates that a single fast on a scorching day can serve as a means of deliverance from the Fire, while also instructing believers not to underestimate the spiritual weight of minor acts of devotion, such as giving half a date, provided they are done with sincere intention to draw near to Allah.

en.hubeali:
A number of companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban Bin Usman, from Bashir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever you intend something from the goodness, so do not delay it, for the servant would Fast on the hot day intending what is in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Free him from the Fire due to it, and you should not belittle what you could get closer with to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, and even though it may be part of a date’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Bashir ibn Yasar from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

When you intend to perform anything good, then do not delay. A man may fast on a hot day and hope thereby to receive what is with Allah, and Allah then sets him free from fire. Do not underestimate the good deeds with which one may seek nearness to Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, even if it is a piece of a date.”
